utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Good morning to you, Madam Registrar and welcome back. Could you kindly call the case, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. This is case number IT-05-88-T, the Prosecutor versus Vujadin Popovic et al.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: I thank you, Madam. Usual advisory to the accused. If there are problems with interpretation please let us know. I see that more or less Prosecution is in full force. I see no -- I notice no significant absences amongst the Defence teams. Okay. No preliminaries, I take it. I just want to make sure of one thing of the first I would like to thank you Mr. McCloskey for the Prosecution for having complied with the directive of the Trial Chamber and having filed the details we requested in relation to the various 271 images that are contained in the CD that we've been going through. I just want to make sure that all the Defence teams have received it. All right. I think it's extremely helpful, Mr. McCloskey, because it gives us an opportunity to see where the images are and you consider to be similar. Okay. Mr. Ruez, good morning to you.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Good morning.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: I hope you had a good weekend. You are going to have a long, tough week with us here, so let's not waste or lose more time and go straight to the continuation of your testimony. Again, you don't need to repeat your solemn undertaking, you've already done -- solemn declaration, you've already made that last week, and it still is in force. Mr. McCloskey will be proceeding with his examination-in-chief.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. McCloskey.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President. Just to bring us up to date we were in the part entitled executions area south. We had visited Luke briefly and now we left off at image 49 on our way into the Cerska valley as Mr. Ruez has testified briefly before, about some witness information he had and so let's continue that trek and go to number 50.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Militia, what's this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is a picture of the entrance of the valley of Cerska where the road is getting more narrow.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Let's keep continuing. Now, 51 what is this an image of?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is a picture of a site that we believed was the execution site we were looking for.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: It's approximately three kilometres deep inside the Cerska valley.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Now, did you find that as a result of witness information or some -- some other information, without getting into any of the information?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This was the pure result of the assistance of witnesses, two sets of witnesses.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. And is there anything in this photograph you want to explain or do you want to go on to the next one?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. On this one, one can already obviously see that there is an area of disturbed soil at the left of the hill, at the left of the picture. And it cannot be seen yet but the right side of the road is a steep slope on which one can currently see that some branches were put on top.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And did you find anything eventually under those branches?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. This will be the topic of the following pictures.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to 52, then. Now, is this the same area from another angle?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is the same area seen from the direction of approach. The top of the picture is the end of the valley so this is the way the transports approached the area. Now, the hill with a missing piece of it, is at the right. That is direction north. And the slope at the edge of the road is at the left, direction south.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to the next one and what is this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is a photograph that shows the slope at the edge of this dirt road and one can see that part of that slope is covered with soil and that the vegetation has not grown on top of it yet.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Can you give us a rough date of when you were there, when this photograph was taken?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This photograph is dated June 1996.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Want to go to the next one? What is this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: We decided to make three probes on the side of the road on a distance approximately 25 metres long, so we probed the site with a prick and once this prick identified possible presence of dead bodies, we made three probes on that side of the hill.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: What is this thing you're calling a prick?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: A prick is a long metal bar, very thin, that one can push into the soil and when it's retrieved, one needs to sniff the end of this prick, probe, and depending on the smell, determine if there is a possibility or not for dead bodies under the soil.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's continue. We are now at 55. We see a close-up of one of the pits that you were digging. What's significant about this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The picture should be reduced to 75 probably to have the bottom of it. So in this first hole that we dug, we could find a few human legs.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to the next one, 56.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: In the one, in the middle, we found the top of a human skull with hair attached to it.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And let's go to the next one, 57.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: In this last probe, we found the skeleton of a man wrapped in a civilian jacket; only the top of his skull can be seen on this picture.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. And how do you know it was a man or were you just saying that?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: We were not with a pathologist that day but this was our assessment and the picture was later shown to Jose Pablo Baraybar, an anthropologist who was with the team and who identified the human remains according to the pictures.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to the next one, 58. Now, this is again a U.S. aerial image called Cerska. It's a split image with 5 August in a circle and -- sorry, 5 July in a circle and 27 July. Can you tell us what this is?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So the interest of this photograph that we got after having found the site is to confirm, indeed, the length of the site that is at the -- on the slope next to the road, so this can be seen at the left of the picture, the picture being at the right of the split picture dated 27 July, as well as the fact that more or less in the same period of time, a piece of soil from the opposite side of the hill was taken away and the disturbance can be seen at the right of the road on the picture dated 27 July 1995.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Mr. McCloskey, one moment. Over the last three days of his testimony, Mr. Ruez's testimony, we've had an opportunity to see a few shots, satellite shots which according to you, Mr. McCloskey, have been provided by the US government. Now, what I would like to know is when were these aerial or satellite shots made available to the witness. For example, we saw shots which, according to the witness, showed groups of persons in a field or in a soccer field, buses, now we see a shot of what is described as disturbed earth. When were these made available to him? All at the same time?

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. President, I will endeavour to do that. What -- with these different shots, especially the grave shots that are related to possible execution sites, as you'll see as he goes through the testimony, sometimes the evidence led him to a spot and then images were requested. Other -- a few times images came and led him to the spot. He has just testified and I may not have made it clear that this spot was found by witnesses and he later got this image but -- I'll have him reiterate that but we'll try to keep that going.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Exactly. I had anticipated this answer, this reply from you. So I suggest that when he goes through now, particularly excavation sites, he does tell us what prompted him to go there, whether it was satellite images first or whether it was information gathered from interviewees, and if he then refers to satellite images, he explains that that -- those came after or when he made use of them to locate the excavation sites.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And, Mr. President, the United States has asked us to refer to these as aerial images and not conclude whether they be satellites or something else.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: All right. Okay.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And just for your information.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: I apologise to the government of the United States and henceforth I will refer to them as aerial images.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: They are watching always, so we have to be --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right, Mr. Ruez, I think on this particular one it's been made clear that witnesses led you to the site and that you found this photo after ward.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Mr. President, I'm not sure we prepared for the exact dates he received this material but we certainly will be able to say whether it was found before or after the individual site.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Mr. Ruez, can you just reiterate when was this -- this image obtained after you found this site or before?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This was -- this picture was obtained after, I would guess probably July or latest August 1995, maybe even just a few days after we returned from this June mission, June 1996.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. And the rectangles on the right indicating disturbed earth, was that consistent with the disturbed earth that you found on the ground?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, absolutely, it was. I need to add as well that the yellow markings are not from the -- since the beginning on this picture. I added them for the sake of the presentation.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And that will be true of all this imagery, if there is any coloured markings that will be OTP markings?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Okay. If we could go to the next one, 59 and can you describe what this photo entails?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So knowing what we already have shown, this photograph shows again the piece of soil missing from the steep hill at the left side of the road, also left of the road you can see two team members at this moment busy collecting shell casings alongside of the road. These shell casings were all found in the area where you can see the vehicles and the two colleagues. I don't remember precisely how many casings were collected. I think it's not more than 60 that day.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Keep going.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: On the yellow arrow on the right of the picture shows the direction towards where the people fell along the slope and then were covered with dirt coming from this hill.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And what are these little numbered yellow things on the grounds that are -- have this blue oval over them?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: They do not mark the possible position of the people who were shot there, though it's the approximate area. They do mark reference points in order then to enable our crime scene technician to pinpoint where we did the probes alongside of the road. So one probe was approximately at number 6 on this picture, another one was number 4, and the first one was number 1 at the end of this picture.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: But not in the road, I take it but --

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, no. On the side, the right side.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Okay. Let's go to the next one. Okay. So we've left Cerska now and we are going down towards Nova Kasaba. So as we see on the map at page 60. Let's go to the photo. We have an aerial imagery dated 13 July, which we'll do a little bit of adjustment. We see -- that's okay. We see three markings, rectangular markings on it. Can you explain where this is and what the significance of it is to the investigation?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is an area between the intersection of Konjevic Polje and Nova Kasaba but much closer to Nova Kasaba than to Konjevic Polje. This is a -- this is a picture on which one can see dotted line at the middle left which is the line of sight of a witness who claims having seen, as he was standing close to a pylon, in between two destroyed houses, three groups of prisoners being shot from individuals who climbed on top of APCs parked alongside of the road.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Do you have your little sheet with that witness's name on it or his number on it, just for everyone?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: He's not on this list because he's not a survivor. This is a list of survivors.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: We'll get that later, Mr. President. Q. Now, what are the two bigger rectangles noting?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. The first the one in red is the location that we believe is the site of the execution. The two rectangles, we'll see them more in depth later, they show that on 13 July there was no disturbance in the area where these two circles are.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: So from this particular image, you're just using it as a map, graphic, you're not using it to indicate any actual disturbance or specific evidence on the ground; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is correct. Only as a reference point related to the angle of vision the person claims having had at that time.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. And let's go to the next shot. And what is this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is a colour photograph of that same area that shows the meadow with one house on top of it, one destroyed house at the bottom, and at the left of the picture, on the hill, you can see a pylon of the same type of those the witness says being in the vicinity of when he saw the events.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: So this meadow in front of us, is that roughly where your red rectangle was in the previous photo?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, this is correct, part of it.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's, at 62 now. Let's go to 63. And what is this? We see a meadow with little yellow stickers on it.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The two colleagues who checked this meadow used a metal detector in order to find bullets or bullet fragments embedded in the soil. So all these yellow markers show the area where such bullets and bullet fragments were found.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Just for reference, is this particular crime scene and many others the subject of a report of one of your investigators?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, indeed. The report was compiled by investigator dean manning.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Sorry to interrupt but I had difficulty when the witness says that witness was not a witness/survivor. Does it mean that he does not remember who said this? Could you clarify this?

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Do you remember the name of the witness that led you to this -- well, from information who you went to this site?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, I don't remember his name but heart. What I meant when I said that this is a list of survivors is that within the team, the witnesses we call survivors are only those who personally survived from a mass execution. Those people who managed to arrive safe to Tuzla, we do not call them internally -- in our internal language survivors. The person who led us to discover this site did not escape from an execution. He managed to find his way out safely but without surviving any type of execution.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: I think I understand. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you, Judge Kwon.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: So we just mentioned this site as a subject of Dean Manning, report. I think we can go on to 64. Now, we have [French translation coming over English channel]?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: One moment. I think we've got a technical hitch. We are receiving interpretation in French on channel 4.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: I thought I was speaking French for a minute. That's okay. All right. Let's see if perhaps we -- okay. I don't hear that any more.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Mr. Ruez, now we have 27 July aerial image and this time the two larger rectangles show some disturbed earth. Now, can you tell us in relation to your investigation the -- what the president had asked about earlier, when in time in the investigation was -- was this received and did you ask for it or was it one that was provided to you, if you recall?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this one has a specific story because it is one of -- one of two, although one that was shown in August 1995 by Madeleine Albright at that time US Ambassador to the United Nations and she showed that at the United Nations in August 1995.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: One moment, Mr. McCloskey, because I think we need to clear this up also in relation to others that we've seen and others that we will be seeing. Who established the criteria to conclude that what is indicated as disturbed earth is indeed disturbed earth? I mean, for example, maybe you can explain it to us rather than I try to understand it.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. President. The these very distinctive US aerial images that I will try to acknowledge as such when one comes up, the area in black and white, in white, where it says areas of disturbed earth and then Nova Kasaba and then the date, that is information provided by the United States that they stand behind as information they are giving us. That's all that we can say about it. We cannot say how they got it, we don't really know most of the time any way.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: I'm not interested in how they got it.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: That is United States information and conclusions. You will see later on photos with little dots and, well, you've already seen some, where the United States has concluded they are people or you'll see one where they concluded they are bodies. So that came to us originally as Rule 70 then they cleared it for use in the courtroom and it's the United States giving their conclusions of what it is. You'll also hear, in as much detail as we want to, Mr. Ruez's information related to the information that the US gives us. So it's -- that's how it works.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Is this being presented in contrast with another aerial view?

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Yes. If you look at the previous aerial image, you will see these two squares without disturbed earth and so that the conclusion is that the disturbed earth happened sometime between I think the previous one was --

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: 13 July and 27.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: 13 July and 27 July. This is the subject matter -- Mr. Ruez will hit a bit on this but Dean Manning will get into a little mor detail because it can get fairly detailed and we wanted Mr. Ruez to give us a basic overview but he can also give us the detail.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Just now to have a visual presentation of it, is it possible for the technicians and whatever to have the two images juxtaposed as we had in the case of Cerska? I know that this is horizontally problematic but if perhaps they could be superimposed one on top of the other instead of one next to another, next to the other?

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: I'm getting the word that we are not that -- the system is not that advanced, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: I see. All right. Can we see the previous one, at least?

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Yes. If we could --

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Two before.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: It's two before, I believe. It's -- yes. There is 13 July, and the two rectangles, and then if we can flip to 27 July, and -- are those rectangles relatively in the same position, Mr. Ruez or did we flip around?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, they are not same position. The angle might be slightly different because it's not the same flight but markings are exactly the same.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: How about trying number 58?

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to 58. Now, this shot was provided to us in this manner by the US so that it would be obvious but they didn't all come like that. Some of them did.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: All right. Let's move ahead. I thank you, Mr. McCloskey, and I thank you, Mr. Ruez.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: But for Your Honours, these Nova Kasaba graves we do not have witnesses of these -- of any executions related to those two bottom rectangles, nor do we have survivors. So this is basically the evidence plus the forensics of the dig that you will get just so that you will know where this is. As we get to graves where we have more information, we may spend a little more time.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Mr. Ruez, I think we've got that. Now, these disturbed earth shots we are going to get into, which the investigation did relate to them, are we not?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, we will for the time being just attract attention to the location of the red box as well as of the rectangle that is at the left of the picture.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. That's the same red box indicating that that site where the bullets and shell casings were found by Mr. Manning and the group?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is correct, and in front of it an area of disturbed soil.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Then let's go to the next shot, 65. Okay. We see here the same at the bottom the same photograph with the disturbed soil circled and then we see green shots. Can you just explain that?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The picture at the bottom is already commented. When standing on the side of the road where the possible execution site is located, and looking in front, you can see on the picture at the top, the colour picture, the area where the disturbed soil was marked. It is in the yellow circle.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. That's clear. Let's go to the next shot, 66. What's this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is a probe that we did in June 1996 of this area that was marked "disturbed soil" on the US aerial imagery.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Is that from the -- part in the circle of the former picture, 65?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, definitely it is more or less in the middle of the area that was shown on the aerial imagery as being disturbed soil.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And this is you and human remains that were found there?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. And the person at the left is John Gerns.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to the next shot. What's this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So during this probe, we exposed six different bodies which were close under the surface. This one you can see at the right of the picture, what is the head of the man. In the middle is his back. And on the sides you can see his arms. The yellow arrow is marking a ligature binding this man at the level of his wrists.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Let's go to the next shot, 68. Okay. This appears to be a different person?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: What is this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So here you can recognise at the left the back of the head of this man. He's wrapped in a civilian jacket and at the right of the picture you can again see his hands. They are on top of a head. The next shot will enable us to see that he was bound as well.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to that shot, then, 69. And what are these two arrows depict on this individual?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The arrow at the left shows a wire ligature that was attached around the wrists of this man, and the arrow at the right shows the position of the fingers. You can see a wedding ring at one of these fingers.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Now, these two sites of disturbed earth that have been identified, were those fully exhumed by the ICTY?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. They were later exhumed. All the sites in this area were later exhumed. I don't remember precisely the total number of bodies. I think 26 in this one and in total it is less than 100 in the area.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: But that is the subject of the forensic archeologists and Mr. Manage; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Absolutely correct, yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And were done under your guidance?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. So I think we are leaving that area and we are going on to the next area, I believe. Yes. And so according to your diagram, I believe we are at the river Jadar. And can you tell us what this red dot means?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this red dot spots the approximate area where this execution is claimed having happened.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And how did you come to this potential or this alleged execution site?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: We had to come back to the site with Witness 35, who led us through the part of his walk when he surrendered at the intersection of Konjevic Polje, and from there, he directed us to the spot in this area where he says, having been shot at together with a group of 16 others.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Well, let's go through your photo accounting of that and you can tell us the significance. Let's go to the next one. Here we are at 71 and can you tell us what this is a photo of?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is again the same photograph I used to show the intersection of Konjevic Polje.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And can you again, we -- orient us again, just this, it's hard to orient it from these photos and we have one new member that might be helped by it, if you could tell us the road on the left, where does that go to?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So the road bottom left is going towards Nova Kasaba. The road at the right is going towards Bratunac. The fifth engineer battalion is a few hundred metres to the right.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay and the road in the middle that is sort of near the red arrow?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: And the road in the middle that goes north is going towards the direction of Zvornik and you have to pass the canyon of Jadar Drinjaca in that direction.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. And this time, this photo has a blue box written in by -- what's that?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So Witness 35 is the one who told us having been first -- not detained but brought to the 5th engineers' barracks and from there, taken to the intersection, and put inside the hangar, and the blue square is showing this hangar at the intersection.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And just as a reminder, this hangar Mr. Ruez has testified is no longer there. There is a gas station there now. All right, and the red arrow?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The red arrow shows the direction that a bus took, a bus loaded with Witness 35 and 15 other prisoners and they took the direction north towards the edge of the Jadar river.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to the next shot, 72. And I see the arrow coming at us in the picture. Can you orient us here?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is seen in the opposite direction but once you will have turned right at the end of the previous picture, the road then hits inside these two huge hills and the arrow marks roughly the area where the bus then stopped. We will see it on the other picture.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Below this --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: One moment because I'm not understanding here. He said previously you turn right. Turn right is if I remember well he said in the direction of Bratunac.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: No. It's a confusion.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: He's put himself on the road driving, not in the picture.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: I think for the record at least he needs to explain that. So this is what was indicated as going north.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, the red arrow. This is the continuity of the previous red arrow but now the picture is seen north to south and not south to north.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: All right. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Underneath that red arrow we see two lines, natural lines. Can you tell us what those two lines are?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The first line at the right of the dotted line is the road, the asphalt road, and the second line at the right is the river, Jadar River.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. And just to clarify, this asphalt road, that's the main road north from Konjevic Polje to Zvornik; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Absolutely, yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Let's go to the next one, 73. What's this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is the road of approach to the site who at this moment is approximately 100 to less than 200 metres in that direction.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's continue to 74. We have a -- looks like a helicopter shot from above. What is this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So it is indeed a picture taken from a helicopter. At the left, this is the road coming from Konjevic Polje. The right is going towards Zvornik. So in the middle, where the arrow starts is a parking lot that could be a kind of bus stop. So a parking area. And the line shows the direction that Witness 35 took. It's a steep hill that goes towards the Jadar river.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: So what got you to this little turnout along the road?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The witness told us to stop at that location.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. And let's go to the next one. And what is this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is the area at the edge of the river where the witness said he had been lined together with the others, more or less where the area of the stones is, and there he was shot at.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. And did you search that area for anything?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So, yes. The area was searched for shell casings. Unfortunately, not one single shell casing was found at that location. But the next photo might provide an explanation for that as well.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Can we see the next photo, 76? What is this designed to depict?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this grouping of logs on the opposite bank of the picture indicate that the water line of this river might be quite high. So quite an important flooding might occur during spring, and my assumption is that the water washed away all possible evidence that could have been found on this site.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Let's leave assumptions aside, Mr. McCloskey, please, and Mr. Ruez let's limit ourselves to what you could establish. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Let's go on to the next one. Okay. Now we're -- we left the Jadar river site and we are going to what you have entitled, "Konjevici and KP 1 and 2." Can you -- before we get to those photographs, can you tell us a bit about what these are?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So we had no major interest in the area of Konjevic Polje, since there were a few witness accounts talking about murders happening in that location, but individual murders, not mass murders. Nevertheless, we had received aerial imagery in 1997 about some suspect sites in this area so we went to these sites and checked the content of them.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to the next shot. It will become clearer. So if I understand you correctly, no witness led you to these sites but the aerial imagery led you to these sites; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. It is correct, because these witnesses would not be called to testify anyhow due to the very short number of dead they could talk about, but since they are suspect sites in the area we still needed to check that.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. So this image, 78, marked KP 1, did you -- was that probed?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it was.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to the next shot. Now, this -- what is this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is a helicopter view of this suspect area that was shown on the previous aerial image.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to the next shot, 80.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The direction of -- are marked on it and the red circle spots the area that was marked as disturbed soil on the previous aerial imagery.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you. Let's go to the next shot. What is this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is a ground picture taken with Nova Kasaba in the back, looking towards Konjevic Polje, and the yellow arrow shows a spot behind a tree line, so hidden from the road, where the area of disturbed soil was visible.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's keep going to the next shot, 81. Entitled, KP probe. What is this, a split shot?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The photograph at the left shows the area of disturbance that we have checked, so the entire area where now the soil is again disturbed and at the location where the little backhoe is positioned, the probe enabled to found -- to find human skull. This area was later fully exhumed.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. And that will be the subject of Mr. Manning's and forensic reports; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is correct.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Mr. McCloskey, if I could go back briefly to Jadar River site, can you see the number 74?

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: So Mr. Ruez said that to the left is the left road is coming from Konjevic Polje and to the right it leads to Zvornik.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: While we are seeing this picture, can we briefly look at the map 6 or map 5, whatever. Is this site marked on this map? Map 6 would be better. Coming from Konjevic Polje leading to Zvornik, where is this site marked on this map? We can put it on the ELMO.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Mr. President -- oh, yes, if we could put it on the ELMO.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Going up. Yes. Could you point to this point on this map?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I would bet that it is the --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Konjevic Polje is there?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Konjevic Polje is here.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: To go to Zvornik you have to go up where is this side.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Here.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: This site is not marked on this map.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour. I'm sure we have a map where that's marked but we will make sure we have that so it's clear.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. If we could go back to -- I think we were getting to the next small site in this same area. If we could go to the next photo, 82. This is -- Mr. Ruez, what's this map, graphic indicate?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this one shows another probe that we did, being led by aerial imagery to a site that is on the road going from Konjevic Polje to Bratunac, approximately 400 metres east from Konjevic Polje.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Let's go to the next one. What's this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is a picture taken from the road in direction of the hills and more or less at the middle of the picture where the tree line is starting, we made a probe as well.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And was that based on the aerial imagery we saw before?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: It was based on these reports of individual murders and having the possibility to maybe being led on one of these sites by indeed aerial imagery.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Then let's go to the next photo. And a grave. What's this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is the result of the search that we did on that spot, and it enabled us to find an individual grave with one body in it.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Let's go to the next shot. And what is this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is a split image that shows the skull of the individual.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. And now let's go on to the next area. Okay. This is entitled, "The Kravica warehouse"; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is correct, yes. The blue dot marks the spot on the map where people were regrouped on a large meadow and the red dot shows the approximate position of the agricultural warehouse of Kravica.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. And can you tell us the names or -- or excuse me the numbers of the principal survivors of this that you were relying on in this next part of your investigation?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Witness 36 for the west part, and Witness 37 for the east part.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: When you say west and east, do you mean the west part of the warehouse and the east part of the warehouse?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, this is correct, west part of the warehouse, east part of the warehouse.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And we'll get to that. So let's go to the next shot. And what does this indicate?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is a photograph I took standing next to the two storage house at Sandici looking toward the east, and the red arrow points at the white structure, yellowish structure of the Kravica warehouse that can be seen at a short distance.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Can you tell us just very briefly how the investigation became aware of a potential incident at this location that we are calling the Kravica warehouse?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: From several sources. Some of them being people who passed that road on board of buses, on July 13. But then mainly during one interview conducted during the summer 1995 with the witness who has the number 36.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: And later, in 1997, an interview and follow-up contacts with Witness 37.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to the next shot. And we are at 88 and this appears to be a helicopter view. Can you tell us from where this is shot and what's it of?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So just at the bottom of the picture is the Sandici meadow. It's not on the picture. It is just at the limit under the picture. So from the bottom of the picture, towards the red square that indicates the location of the Kravica warehouse, one can have a sense of the distance between the meadow and the warehouse.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And beyond the warehouse, what town is in that direction, just again to orient us?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Then it is the village of Kravica, and going further towards the east would be Bratunac town.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. And perhaps we can blow that up slightly to get a better picture of the warehouse.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: We will have better ones later.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go, then, to 89. And what does this depict, 89?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this picture shows the warehouse, the one we call the warehouse, because it is a warehouse complex made of four warehouses, but we only refer to "the warehouse" the one that is parallel to the road, and on this picture, framed with a red rectangle.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: What's the purpose of the blue arrow?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The blue arrow shows the direction of arrival of the prisoners who were taken there. Some by bus and others by foot.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Could we go to the next shot?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: One moment. That would be from direction from the direction of Bratunac?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: No. From the direction of Sandici.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Sandici, okay. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Now we have a split image shot. The one on the top appears to have snow on the ground, and the one on the bottom was the same as the last one. I think you previously testified about being in this area in the winter. Can you just briefly reiterate what that shot is on the top so we all are aware of that?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: First the picture at the bottom, the general view of the warehouse, that was a helicopter flight I think was dated 1997, summer 1997. The area boxed in red shows what we call the west part of the warehouse, that is referred to as the picture -- that is on the top with another red box. The picture at the top was indeed taken during the mission of January 1996. So it is the picture taken at a time that is the closest to the events that we have in our possession.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And as you testified previously, the -- this winter 1996 shot, that you were with a diplomat John Shattuck and you did not examine the grounds of the warehouse and do a full investigation; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it is correct. We only briefly went inside and took some sample on the walls, just to have a blood test and check if it was human or animal blood.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. So let's go to the next shot, 91. What does this signify?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this one is showing the east part of the warehouse, the one we call the east part, both seen from the air and from the ground. It's two very distinctive parts of the warehouse.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And could you remind us, you said one witness was -- the investigation revealed was from the east and one or was at the east part of the warehouse and one was at the west. Can you tell us which is which by number?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Witness 36 was in the west part and Witness 37 in the east part.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to the next shot. All right. Now we have a split image. On the right corner is another US image dated 13 July, with that squiggly 1400 hours which we've learned means approximately 1400 hours. And then another shot, a more -- a green shot of the warehouse. Tell us what this signifies.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is still the east part of the warehouse. We knew from the Witness 37 that he was taken there by bus, before being taken inside this east part, and the picture, the aerial picture dated 13 July, shows that at that moment, just at that moment, two buses were parked in front of this east part of the warehouse.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. And then the shot up to the left, is that -- what's that for?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is in order to enable the Court to see where these two buses were parked at the east part.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to the next one. And this?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: One moment. Mr. Ruez, bottom part of this picture, I mean the main photo actually, between the building which we are referring to as the warehouse, which is parallel to the road, in other words, and the first building, which is at vertical 90 degrees respect to the road, there seems to be another shed or small shed. You can see it. Can you follow me?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I'm not sure.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Between the warehouse and the building to its left, there is on the green part what appears to be another building which seems to me to be at least twice as long as the truck that is on the road.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, I see it.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: All right. Now, if we can -- if we go back to the aerial view that we have just seen, the previous shot, 92, I don't see it there.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: So do you have an explanation for that?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes. Yes. This is not a permanent structure. It's a -- I mean, during the years 1996, 1997 and further on, this warehouse has been used to store material. At one point there were a lot of bricks, on another timing there were logs. This, I believe, is a -- is some wooden structure there that is not a permanent structure.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Just to make sure of this, can we go back now, whole series of photos of the Kravica warehouse, starting from 86, then, please, 87, all right, 88, 89. So we have it on 89. Do you have the date of this photo, please? This seems to be exactly the same date as the previous one that we saw because the truck is there as well. Although it seems that the truck is parked there. It's not exactly on the road.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes. The helicopter picture is always the same one because this is the best shot we have of the complex.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Okay. And that would be on what date?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: That, I think, not hundred per cent, is summer 1997.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: All right. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: At a time where the reconstruction of the facade had started and that was indeed summer 1997.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: All right. Thank you. Let's move to the next one, 90. So, okay. Go to 91. And eventually 92, where we were, yeah. Okay.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Thank you, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Let's go to 93.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Same applies incidentally just for the record, alongside the vertical building, there seem to be two green patches, lawn patches, or -- which do not show on the satellite image. Or they could be there, yeah, they are there. They can just be seen. All right. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. And what's the significance of this shot?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this one is to introduce now the pictures related to the inside of this warehouse, the west part of the warehouse.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. And let's go to that. And when you say inside, what date, if you know, the photographs of the inside?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: These ones are June 1996, though we have same ones in -- already in April 1996, and some were taken in January, but these ones were better quality. These ones are June.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. And what are the yellow arrows pointing out?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So the yellow arrows are pointing to residues that are the topic of a long report explaining it is human residues, blood, tissue, hair.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Again that report is a forensic report that will be dealt with in Mr. --

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Dean Manning, testimony.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay, the next one, 95?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Again, traces explosive residues that can be see seen at the bottom of the picture, for example.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Perhaps it's quicker. Did survivors indicate they were shot with automatic weapons and with hand grenades thrown in the building?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. This is correct, yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: On what basis does he establish that what we see in the picture are traces of explosive residues?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Based on the report that was produced on it later.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you. In other words, visually, do they present themselves in a characteristic way that you can immediately distinguish them as explosive residues or do you have no basis to come to that conclusion on just a visual analysis, then you have to follow up with a proper forensic analysis?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: When you see at them, you guess; once you have a result from a lab you're certain that your guess was a good one.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Ruez. Yes, Mr. McCloskey?

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Then let's go to the next photograph.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is a photograph of a live grenade that was found just in front of the warehouse in the ditch alongside of the road.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Do you know the date?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: I'm cheating. I have some photographs which have the date on it, bottom right, but it's very hard to read. It's summer 1996, I would guess June. It was either June or August, one of the two.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. And how close is this to the warehouse wall?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Ten to 15 metres.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Let's go to the next shot. And what is this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is a grenade handle, one of the grenade handles that we found around the warehouse, mainly at the northwest corner of the warehouse, so at the back of it.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to the next one. And what's this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is a hole facing a window that is at the opposite, a hole made by some device in the concrete wall of the warehouse.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to the next shot.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: And --

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: What's this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is the same hole seen from the outside of the warehouse, at the back of the warehouse.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Let's go to the next shot. And what's the significance of this shot, number 100?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Witness 36 said that once he entered the warehouse he found shelter into what he calls a guard house inside the warehouse, and this is where he hid and managed to survive, avoiding the explosions and the shots in that guard house.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Let's --

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: And this is the arrow that points to the location where this guard house was at one time located.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Let's go to the next shot to see that. All right. Is this the area that roughly that arrow was pointing to?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is precisely the area. On this picture, I have no doubt of the date because it's written 12 April 1996.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And I don't see a guard house.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So indeed, the guard house has been destroyed since then. One can see obvious marks on the wall that indicate the fact that there was something at that location, as well as one can see at the bottom that there was a line of blue tiles to separate this area from the rest.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to the next picture, then. 102. What is this of? And how is it related to the --

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Just next to one of the warehouse's doors was a pile of rubble, when we arrived on the spot, we searched through that pile of rubble and found a certain number of objects. In the middle one can see a bunch of shell casings. At the bottom left, fake teeth. At the top, two cover pages of identity documents. And at the right, according to what Bill Haglund told us, being a pathologist who came with us during that search, the white pieces are human bones fragments.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to the next shot. Now, what's this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this again now shows the area that we call the east part of the warehouse.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Indicating the next series of shots?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Indicating the next series, indeed.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to 104, then. What's this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is the wall at the back of the warehouse when entering it by the large openings.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And what was the significance of this photograph?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: One can see a certain number of bullet holes at the back of this wall.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Let's go to the next one, 105. What's this yellow arrow?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This arrow marks a stain on the wall that I went to collect due to the fact that this part of the warehouse had not been processed by the team of forensic experts, so we had no blood analysis on that part. So we end up having this one, the sample was sent to the lab and the result was a human blood.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to the next shot, 106. I take it that's just a close-up of the last one?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Just a close-up of the sample, yeah.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to the next one. What's this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this arrow points to one window and it is through this window that the Witness 37 says, having jumped out, it leads to the back of the warehouse.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to the next shot. What's this, 108?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is a view of a back of the warehouse. The window that is the most at the right is the one where the witness believes having jumped out of.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Just where the little hand is circling?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you. Let's go to the next shot. What is this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is a view now of the front of the warehouse, and there is a window at the left of this picture under which something can be seen on the next picture.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Then let's go to the next picture, which is 110. So where in relation to the window is this image?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is just underneath the window. It's a shoe trace. And the shoe is pointing towards the bottom.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Let's go to the next shot. Okay. Can you remind us what this is a still of?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is a still extracted from the video taken by Mr. Petrovic on the spot, in July 1995.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. As he's driving by the warehouse; is that right?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, driving by the warehouse, and --

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Direction?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Direction Bratunac, coming from Sandici.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. And --

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The interest of this one will be to make a comparison of the impacts that can be seen on the walls.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go through that, then. Now, can you explain this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. So the problem we might face trying to compare bullet impacts on the picture dated July 1995 and the ones dated January 1996 is that once the door of the warehouse was reconstructed in August 1997, the way it was reconstructed does not enable us to use the picture for comparison. The reason is that the warehouse's door has not been reconstructed in the way it existed in July 1995.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Now, did the investigation reveal anything happening to that door on July 13th, 1995?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. According to Witness 36, once he was inside, and that the execution was finally over, he heard the distinctive sound of a heavy equipment that broke inside the warehouse. So the door frame of this warehouse was later found at the bottom of one of the mass graves at the Glogova site.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Well, we'll get into that a bit later as will Dean Manning but that's your explanation for this broken door frame that we see in the left, the lower left shot, from January 1996 with the snow?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, indeed, yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Then one could believe, because of some distortion of the video of Mr. Petrovic, that the size of the door at the bottom is the same one in 1995 and in 1997, though, in fact, we will show that this is not the case. It's a distortion of the photograph.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: I think that will become clear as we go, I hope. And of course if anyone has questions.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President, it is a good time to break.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: I thank you, Mr. McCloskey, Mr. Ruez. We will have a 25-minute break. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. McCloskey, let's proceed. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President. I think we've discussed 112, and we can continue with the explanation about the door on to 113. Okay. And I think we can try and get that whole --

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Well, Mr. Ruez, can you explain what this is?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The one before?

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: You want to go back to 112? All right. Let's go back to 112. All right?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So the goal is to check if they are more or less bullet holes in the vicinity of this door between July 1995 and January 1996. And in order to do that, one needs first to have a reference point in terms of height of these holes in comparison with the height of the door. On this picture, one can see that between the 1st January 1996 and August 1997, one part of this door has been rebuilt and that this reconstruction puts the height of the new door at the level of the top of the windows that are to the right and to the left.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to the next shot.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So here again, determining the height is important because if one does not take in consideration the way the door has been reconstructed, some bullet holes that seem at the bottom of the wall are in fact at a medium height of the door. This can be noticed if you look at the bullet holes or the holes marked in yellow on the top and the bottom picture. In fact, on the top picture, the area in between red bars is an area that is later missing.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: When was the bottom picture taken?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: The bottom picture here was taken in April 1996 but the holes are the same ones than the pictures of January 1996, the first ones that were taken, by you use this one taken in April because it is of better quality than the one taken in January.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Mr. Ruez, I think when you first referred to it these marks you called them impact marks. Let's stick with what you started with and I think that may avoid some problems though I think everyone knows what we are talking about. All right. Anything else from this shot?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Not for this one.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: One moment, can I see 112 again, please?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: So here again the one important detail is that the upper part of the door is now at the level of the upper part of the windows that are right and left.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Right.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: We've seen that. Let's go to 114. What's the purpose of this illustration

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this one is the left door of the west part and it shows that the left door was constructed not -- the top of the door was not at the level of the top of the windows but closer to the bottom of these windows. And one can also notice that the door at the left is closely framed by two concrete bars and then comes another bar, but the door is in between two bars.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Did you say it was west part.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: This is still the west part but there are two doors at the west part, one being at the right, the one that was destroyed, and one at the left. This is the one at the left.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. I think the next shot is --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: And the small doors supposedly were the guard house, guard room was, no.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Absolutely. This is the one where the witness entered.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Now we are going sort of as we view the warehouse, back towards the right, I believe; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. Now we are back on the right door of the west part, but close to what it looked like at the time of the events, knowing that on this picture I had added -- I have added the missing bar that was framing this door probably in the same way than the other one, as well as a correction of the height of the door. In fact, I on purpose did it -- put it more high than it should. It should be even at the first third of the level of the bottom of the windows. Here I put them more up. But when doing so, one then can make a better correlation with the photograph taken at the time of the events, since some bullet markings now return in the more or less -- in the position of the middle height of the door, no more at the bottom of the door.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. So this helps us make more sense out of the video, is that the purpose of this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, absolutely, and mainly to determine the proper emplacement of this bullet impacts.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Mr. McCloskey, will we hear some more evidence on this issue, whether this is the identical place or not? Are you going to rely on militia's only?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: So we'll have a direct witness referring to the place.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Yes, you'll have two survivors, one in one side and one in the other.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: In relation to Mr. Petrovic's video.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. Petrovic's video we are going to have one investigator that will show you the whole thing. The part you missed yesterday, it gets a little complicated, we will have one witness that will talk all about the Petrovic video and the B92 video that -- we see in the right-hand corner a televised version of the Petrovic video that we did not obtain originally as part of the investigation. And that -- we obtained it later. Mr. Borovcanin provided that to us. And so you will see Petrovic video and the televised version of the video and get another, more in-depth analysis of it, though this is the best analysis you will see of the door and the reconstruction and the bullets. But you will see other evidence that -- that impact marks were created on the front of this building after this video was shot. That's what Mr. Ruez is talking about. You will actually see witnesses that say they were there when the shooting was going on, they left, they came back, and the shooting continued. So that's what you'll see.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes. Let us see what the Defence would raise here, if any, so okay, thank you let's proceed.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. Lazarevic?

utterances.speaker: MR. LAZAREVIC
utterances.text: I was listening very carefully to what my learned colleague is talking about and he referred a number of times as to these footage as Petrovic footage but I haven't heard him that he intends to bring Mr. Petrovic as a witness here so maybe we can clarify this right now because I believe that it is a highly important witness and he never mentioned his name among witnesses that he intends to call on these events.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Do you wish to remark on that, comment on that, Mr. McCloskey?

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Yes. Mr. Petrovic is on our witness list, number 164.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: And again, he is not a protected witness, is he?

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: The journalist that has been public on this. He may ask but it's not one that I have taken an abundance of caution for but you never know what may happen in Belgrade.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: All right. Thank you, so let's continue.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And, Your Honours, I do appreciate those questions because it allows us to be able to target your concerns because many of the witnesses that have testified are testifying for particular reason, that is -- may not be abundantly clear at the time they are testifying but -- so I appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right, Mr. Ruez --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: I raised this in order to invite you, enjoin you to as cautious as possible because people have been shot and killed and I don't want anything to happen to anyone. Yes, go ahead.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right, thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: So Mr. Ruez, I think you've spoken briefly about this but we have the Petrovic scene and the recreation that you've tried to put the door back in its original place, is that roughly correct?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. This is correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. So in this shot, they look similar?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Now they do.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. And in later shots, the perspective changes a bit; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The prospective of the door frame in the film is anyhow subject to a small distortion due to the angle it is filmed.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. We'll get to that. Let's go to the next shot. Okay. And what's the --

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is -- this shows clearly that when you look at the original picture, July 1995, the right part of the door, where a certain number of impacts can be seen, is totally out of use for the sake of any explanation about bullet holes in the wall, since the entire part that is framed with this orange lines is missing.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. And this is number 116, for the record. Thank you. Let's go to the next illustration, 117. Now, what have you done here?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So now, first, on the right part of the picture, the three bullets which are on a line that are circled in blue are relevant to those that can be seen on the picture at the bottom, and also circled in blue. At the left, the area shown on the two pictures is the one that is in a red box. In this box, one can see one straight line of, let's say three lined impacts and one impact more at the top, to the right. Again, on the picture, the original picture, the distortion makes it that the distances between the top hole and the bottom left hole seems to be a bit longer.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. So let's go to the next shot, 118. Now, we see that it appears to be the same as the previous shot but we now have some holes that are circled in red at the bottom. What's the significance of that?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So taking them first on the right part, one can notice that in between the time the two pictures were taken, there is one more bullet hole just next to the bottom of the line of three that is at the right of the picture and take the left part of the picture, one can count that there are two plus one additional impact holes on the wall.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to the next shot. Actually --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: One moment, one moment. The picture in the bottom, the bottom picture is subsequent to the one on top?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Now, can we go back to 117 and then slowly to 116 again, please? All right. Can we go to 116? And the previous one, 115, please? All right. So now again we go back 116, 117.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Your Honour, just for perhaps the recollection --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: 117, okay. One moment, 117. And 118? So it is your position, Mr. Ruez, that the three holes we see at -- between 10 and 11.00 to the three holes on the right-hand side were in the part, the concrete part, that was no longer existent when the shot -- when the picture in the bottom was taken. Is that correct or not?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I put in reference with the two pictures the three bullet holes that are circled yellow on the picture at the top, and then in that same grouping of impacts, at the -- in the picture on the bottom I say that there is one more bullet hole next to one of the impacts that we can see, the picture, that is, on the top. And on the left side, I count three more than in July 1995.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: But I'm more interested in the right-hand side, the three shot in a triangular -- three holes in a triangular.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Line?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Yes, pattern. Would those be all part of the wall which no longer was existent in -- when the photo in the bottom was taken? Because especially the one, the right, extreme right.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
