utterances.text: Yes, if we -- I could have added on the picture on the top the line where the destruction occurs, one can see the picture at the bottom, if we take the impact totally at the bottom, that the destruction starts a few centimetres to the left. So doing the same at the picture at the top would show that the one, two, three, four, five, six, seven holes that are at the left of the yellow circle are part of the destroyed piece of wall.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Okay. All right. That's your position. I will not comment on that obviously. It can be -- questions can be asked later on, on it. Thank you. Let's proceed, thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Staying here, I don't know how to exactly call the long metal pole.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Concrete poles.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Concrete poles. The right side pole disappeared at the reconstruction but the left one, was it replaced? I note the difference in thickness, and every pole seemed to me different from the previous -- from the upper picture.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: The pole that you see at the -- on the picture at the bottom is a fake one. It's a pole that I have added on the picture.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: No, left one.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: The left one has been untouched.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: But I think the thickness seems to be different, am I correct or not?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: You are correct because it's a question of angle of vision. The one you can see just in front of the objective of the photo camera, the one at the left, you already can see a bit of the thickness so it seems larger. The one more at the left, the effect is even increasing. It's the same when you look towards the right. It's a visual effect. They are absolutely all of the same shape, same size.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Your Honour f it may help explain it the top video that you -- or the top picture you see where it looks thicker, this is a reflection of a moving shot as a car goes across the front, and we have seen that, but -- so this is a still of what is a moving shot. And that is, I believe, as Mr. Ruez said in the explanation.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: So my original question was whether you have -- you are going to produce some scientific analysis on this issue.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: You are going to rely on Mr. Ruez's evidence in relation to this issue? That was my question. And I take it your answer was yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Yes. And one brief moment into private session?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Let's go into private session for a while, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOURGON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President. We have no problem or objection with the witness testifying about what he considers to be visual effects and we can -- we have cross-examination for this purpose but we would appreciate if my colleague would refrain from testifying in lieu of the witness and I refer here to page 47 lines 7 to 11 as an example and page 49, lines 10 to 14. If my colleague wants to put this in his closing argument, so be it but at this point in time we would prefer to hear from the witness. Thank you, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: All right. Thank you. Let's continue, Mr. McCloskey. Point taken, Mr. Bourgon.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Mr. President, would you prefer that I don't try to explain these things?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: No. Let's put it like this. One has to distinguish between one kind of testimony and information and another. I think in as far as the witness had previously testified already that during the excavations or exhumations carried out in some location, they had also dug up pieces of concrete that according to him corresponded to the missing part of the doorway, then of course Mr. McCloskey has every right to refer to it. So I don't see any problems. Please, let's -- when it's substitution of witnesses' evidence, we will intervene but not.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: I understand that.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: In relation to the thickness the witness also referred to that and Mr. McCloskey explained it somewhat in detail. I don't see any problem there. So let's get on with it.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Let's stick to when it is really serious. Yes Mr. Bourgon?

utterances.speaker: MR. BOURGON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President. I just want to clarify what I was saying. In the lines in the examples I referred to it was my understanding that Mr. McCloskey was trying to justify and explain why a picture was seen by saying that it was a video picture and that it was the reason why you could not see the thickness. I mean, I was just under the impression that this is information that should come from the witness.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: But it's also an explanation that we ourselves solicited. I mean let's proceed. Mr. McCloskey, yes, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Mr. Ruez testified that at the beginning of this that there was distortion because of the video.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: In any event, I think Mr. Ruez, we are done with these photos and as you had in other sites, was there a video taken of the Kravica warehouse scene?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, there was one of the first search, and in addition to that, the report that was also mentioned by the Judges is the report of a team of forensic experts from the naval intelligence service, US service, and this mission was conducted by them in September, I think, 1996.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay and who is shooting the video we'll soon see?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The video we will see is a shot by Peter Nicholson and the voice we will not hear with the dates and the description of the items is the voice of Peter Nicholson.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Well, I think for simplicity sake we decided the other day it's better to go without the sound but we will provide any key information that he relates to us, but I think for the purpose of this we can see the video, and Mr. Ruez can narrate it, if that's agreeable.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Let's go with the video and if I could -- I'll sit down.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: We are proceeding along the same lines as we did last week, on the assumption that there are no objections from the Defence teams. And since I have heard none, okay, let's proceed.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: This is again the Sandici meadow. I filmed this little piece in August 1997 to show the distance between Sandici and Kravica. Then be -- back in 1996. So this is at the level of the two storage house at Sandici and zooming towards the Kravica warehouse, in the middle of the picture. This is a helicopter view. At the bottom left is Kravica. Then there is open land, and the Kravica warehouse. The geography behind the warehouse is of interest for one of the witnesses who escaped from the back of the warehouse, going through a corn field, then another field and then up here in forest. Crossing a little brook. So here, for example, you can see piles of logs in front of the warehouse. They were not there in 1995. Logs and piles of bricks. The date was on the picture.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Can we get -- delete the audio, folks in the booth?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Just behind this fence was the grenade. So this is the entrance that took the Witness 36. Yes, getting inside. The former guard house at the left.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: We have not noted the counter but perhaps it's simpler just to let it run.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: So that's a view of the destroyed entrance, from the inside. That's the back of the warehouse. And a former cornfield. On that cornfield, Peter Nicholson is zooming on shell casings. Back at the front of the warehouse. Now he's entering the east part. The prisoners were sitting at the left. The inside of the warehouse has not been cleaned so far. Maybe it is done now but last year there were still a lot of samples to be collected inside. Here is a pile of rubble that we were searching through. The location where the live grenade was found. The result of that search that I already described. Yellow markers that pinpoint the position of shell casings that were found on the area of grass in front of the meadow -- in front of the warehouse. Now making the tour of the warehouse, at the back. That's a grenade handle. So this is the back of the warehouse, one grenade handle, that's another grenade handle, one more grenade handle, two more grenade handles, a shoe, an additional grenade handle. He's returning on the same area. That's the same. I think he was missing one or two handles. And now he's showing the window at the back of the warehouse, under which the handles were found, as well as the other window. He's showing shell casings. Shell casing. Fragment of identity card. Another cover of ID. Fragment of a skull. This is behind the warehouse complex, passing a little brook and going then to the direction of the hills. That is the escape route of survivor 37. And this is a skeleton find -- found behind, and that pathologist Bill Haglund is reconstructing. Another grenade handle, in front of the warehouse.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. And for the record, this video is 65 ter number 1575. All right. So now we are moving beyond Kravica. Where is our next stop, Mr. Ruez?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The next one is the location where the prisoners who survived that day were transported to, that is Bratunac town.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Let's go to 119. And this is a U.S. image dated 12 July, I believe similar to one we had seen before. This time there are some notations on it. And what do you want to call our attention to on this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The interesting spots here are the three arrows at the right marking the location of the Vuk Karadzic school, that is a known extension side, the hangar behind the Vuk Karadzic school, as well as the old school.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Thank you, let's go on.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: One moment, this was -- photo was provided without time indication; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, it is correct.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: And the yellow markings were done for the sake of the trial of General Krstic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: And we are not in a position to know when this was taken, when this was shot?

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you. Except that it does confirm that it was shot on the 12th of July. It's the time that I am referring to in particular, not the date.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And Mr. President, we can always request -- if the Court would like the times, we can request that.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Because we have seen another one, almost identical to it with the buses lined up in the area adjacent to the football field.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Yes. We have not -- we --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: It is the same one actually -- actually, yes. The buses, you can still see them over there, buses you can see. Is this the same photo we saw earlier on, Mr. Ruez?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, it is exactly the same one and according to the shade it's obviously around noon.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: We will be calling an Indian guide that will be helping us with that, Your Honours. We were very economical with our requests to the US about times. Back then, as I said if the court would like us to make any request, we can.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Which was the previous one that we saw?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: It's the same one.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Was it number 10? No. Graphic. Bratunac flyover. Number 11.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Yes. That's number 11.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: 11, yeah.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: All right. Okay. Thank you. Let's move.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Let's go back to where we were. Okay. Let's go to the next shot. And orient us to the -- to these photos, on 120, please?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The idea of this is to show how the place looked like at one point. This is probably dated summer 1997, at the -- when entering the Vuk Karadzic school complex, the Vuk Karadzic school is at the left of the picture. Then the white wall corresponds to the gymnasium of the Vuk Karadzic school. At the right of the gymnasium is the so-called hangar that I know does not exist any longer nowadays. And at the right of this hangar is the so-called old school that was also used as a detention centre.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: The part of the picture that shows according to you Vuk Karadzic school, is it the front or the rear of the building?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: This is the rear of the building.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: I thought so.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: The front is alongside of the street.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. If we can go to the next image? This is -- looks similar to the image we've seen already. For some reason there is not a date on it. What's the purpose of this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The purpose of this was to show the main locations where prisoners were to be seen in Bratunac town on 13 July. So the red circle spots the Vuk Karadzic school, hangar and old school. The line in front is not in the good position. It's a line that symbolises buses and trucks. In fact, it was not parallel to the school, but lined in the street just in front of the school. The line at the bottom of the picture shows a line of buses -- symbolises a line of buses in front of the Vihor garage. One line is policing in centre town but I was not certain about it. Next to Hotel Fontana. And the line at the top of the picture symbolises a few buses that were seen by UN military personnel in front of the Bratunac Brigade headquarters.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: I think that's all for Bratunac and we are moving on. Now we are going up --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: One moment. And at the line of the -- at the top of the picture, and at the line at the top of the picture symbolises a few bus that is were seen by you and military personnel in front of the Bratunac Brigade headquarters." Which one? Oh, I see the red line that crosses the box.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes because the box is hiding the so-called Kaolin factory and the HQ was in front of this factory.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: All right. That's the UN military personnel. I suppose you have got evidence on this, Mr. McCloskey?

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Yes. There is lots of people.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: That's enough. That's enough. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And we also have another photograph that doesn't block out the headquarters but that we'll bring in through another witness.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: And why does he -- the photo also indicate any -- the location of the SDS office? What's the relevance of that?

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: There is a witness you'll be hearing, Mr. Deronjic, the head of the SDS and he was at his office at various times during the events.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go ahead.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Now, we have on the outline a note of a video of the Nova Kasaba graves. Is that meant to be played now?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it could be played now, absolutely.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Then if we could do that. So we are going back into the chronology of our presentation, back to Nova Kasaba.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Yes, sorry for that interruption, Mr. McCloskey.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: If we could play this? And Mr. Ruez, if you could have your same limited narration that we appreciated before? This is 65 ter 1686.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: So to have a feeling much how the area looks like here, this is coming out of the valley of Cerska, intersection of Konjievici they left and currently flying along the road that goes to Nova Kasaba. And here just in the middle of the picture is the supposed execution field we are talking about, and at the left the mass grave areas. Now the zoom in is on a second mass grave area. Still the road in the direction of Nova Kasaba, in the direction of the soccer field and behind is Nova Kasaba town. Here is Nova Kasaba town. Overflying Nova Kasaba and returning direction north. In the middle, the soccer field, middle left, right here. Then the beginning of the hill that goes at its highest elevation at the intersection of Konjevic Polje. So this is the area from which the people could overlook the asphalt road before trying to find a way to cross the asphalt road. Again, the suspect execution site bottom left and the mass grave area just in front of it.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Well, that concludes what you've entitled executions area south. Now your outline is entitled, "Executions area north." And if we could go to 120 -- okay, let's start there and we see that on this, 122, you've circled a yellow dot in the area of or Orahovac. Where is our next stop?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This shows the area between Srebrenica and Kraj -- the town of Bratunac and the first known detention side in what we call indeed area north, that is the school we used to name as being the Grbavci school but that seems also to be the Orahovac school. We used to name it Grbavci.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Before we get to this Orahovac or Grbavci school, can you briefly tell us how you became aware of this school, if you recall?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, for sure. During the summer 1995, we interviewed several persons who claim having been detained in a school that had a gym attached to it and that was in the area close to Zvornik, and then after having been taken to an execution site, they had as a reference point a railroad line. Our first attempt to identify the location came through a teacher who was a refugee in Tuzla and who had worked in that area and who said that the only school with a gym in this area west of Zvornik was that Grbavci school. Unfortunately we couldn't find any map that was showing a railroad, the railroad, but finally, we could get one, and then could narrow down a suspect area. On that basis we requested aerial imagery through the US embassy and gained access to imagery that enabled us to pinpoint the execution sites attached to these detention sites.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Well, with that background, let's go through your -- the images or the photos you've chosen. I think the first one will be 123. And tell us about this.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is a helicopter view of the Grbavci school. At the right of the picture, the road would lead to the main road going from Zvornik towards Tuzla, going to the left of this picture goes to an area where there is not much to be seen and at 800 metres to that direction, that is north, two meadows that will be execution sites. On this picture, one can see the main building with the black roof. The white area at its left is the play ground, and the white structure with brownish roof is the gymnasium of that school.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: One moment. Does this represent the totality of Orahovac or if not -- if yes, at the background, there seems to be another conglomeration of buildings, at least I wouldn't say whether that's a village or whatever. Do you know what that is, Mr. Ruez?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, in fact, the area that on map is labelled Orahovac is the area that you can see at the top of this picture, where there is this grouping of houses.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: All right. So what we see in the bottom of the picture is at the periphery of the village.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, it is.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Mr. Ruez, is it possible you're mistaken and at the Grbavci area?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, you're correct. This is the Grbavci area and to the opposite side, on the left where the graves are is the area of Orahovac, you're right.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Let's go to the next shot. Okay. We see, we are at 124 and we are now back to the snow shots. Is this the same trip in January 1996 that we saw from the Kravica shots?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, indeed, it is. I used there one because it is the one closest to the late of events so hopefully minimum of changes occurred. This one is of interest because it shows in the middle of the picture a metallic fence and this fence is described by at least more than one of the people who went through this school since they claimed having walked along a fence before entering the gym and having to drop their belongings on a pile just before entering. So there is in the middle is the fence that was shown to the witnesses who recognised it as such.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to the next shot, 125. What is this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is the inside of the gymnasium with one door labelled "entrance" and the other one marked "exit." Goes to a ward robe and going through this ward robe is another door that exits on the play ground in front of this gym.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Now, this terms "entrance," why did you choose to call that door the entrance is it? Is that based on something?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Based on the witnesses' accounts. This is the door through which they entered the gym and the other door, the door through which they exited the gym.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Do you know, this picture, 125, was this the January 1996 shot or was this later?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: No. This was sometime later, probably April 1996.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Let's --

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Or could even be later, sorry, could been returned several times.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Let's go to the next shot, 126?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: In fact, this one was really later. It was when we came back with two much the survivors, so 1998.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. And what's this, 126?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: To check the testimonies of the people who said that the men who were guarding them were from time to time shooting above their heads, towards the windows or the ceiling, we checked the ceiling, and this is one bullet hole or one hole in the ceiling, one round little hole in the ceiling.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to the next --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: One moment. Only one hole that you were able to see?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: No. There were at least three of them. This one is showing one. Another photograph is showing two more, I think.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: All right.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: The following one.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: So at most you saw three holes which you seem to conclude are bullet holes?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Let's go to the next shot, 127.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: That's a view of another one.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to 128. What's this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is a picture from the inside of the gym taken from another angle. That was shown to the survivors and at least one of them identified the shape of the windows.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to 129.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This picture depicts some suspect traces on the windows of this gym. I didn't count all of them. There were more than these four but this was the most compelling, let's say.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to 130.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is -- there are two things on this picture. First, the structure at the top left of the picture, with the door with bars, this is the exit door of the wardrobe.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: What's the significance of that to the investigation?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: According to the survivors, they were first taken out of the gym going through that wardrobe where they were given a sip of water and were blindfolded before getting on board of the TAM truck.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: This -- Mr. Ruez, first time you visited this Grbavci school, had it been resumed being used as a school or not yet?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: No, in January 1996, it was empty. During the year 1996, it was empty as well. I would say it was restarted becoming a school during the year 1997.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: All right. And this photo goes back to when?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: This is June 1996.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: 1996. So in June 97.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: No, April 1996.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: April 1996, thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. So just while we are on this barred door, we'll -- does that area change during your subsequent visits to the area?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Later it will change. I will show a picture of it. This door that is later been sealed.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: How?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: With -- with blocks of -- I don't know the name in English.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. We'll get to that photo. And what else did you want to mention in this photo besides that door?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So here is a pile of rubbish and we went through a search through this pile of rubbish in order to check if there were any items of interest.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to the next shot. And what is this? The split image?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is the partial result of our search through this pile of rubbish. It is more detailed in the video that is commented by Peter Nicholson who gives numbers of shell casings and cloth but mainly what we found among the rubbish was strips of cloth and shell casings.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Let's go to 132. What's this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: These are among pieces of cloth, we also find this cater pillar track with cloth attached to it and with knots.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Let's go to 133. What's this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: After having gone through all the cloth we found there, we selected a certain number of tissue in order to later send them to a lab and compare these items with other cloth that would be found in other places or in mass graves.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And was that -- was that done and will it be the results of Mr. Manning's report or others?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The entire crossing of the evidence will be indeed explained by Dean Manning.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Let's go to the next one.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: There is no date on this photograph but I think I can date it 1998. We returned with two survivors to the execution sites, and when we passed by the school, I took this picture because the wall had been sealed off. Not the wall. The exit of the wardrobe.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Now, I note on your outline that we have a four-minute video of the Grbavci school. Is this another Peter Nicholson video?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it is.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay, if we could go through that and if you could do your narration? I think we've seen this?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: At the bottom you can see the railroad line and then the school. This is entering the school, the fence is at the right. That's the entrance. Towards the right it would go to the school and towards the left it goes to the gym. Entrance, exit. Pieces of cloth, but these ones were not in the gym in January 1996. Some kids brought it in later. The pile of rubbish. So now he's giving a description of the items found, having counted them. He's currently counting the different calibres and the numbers. These are a bunch of ammunition belts, boxes of ammunition, gas canisters. Now counting the pieces of cloth.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Mr. President, that was 65 ter 1701, and it may be good time for a break.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Perfect. I would take it we need 30 minutes because of the redactions. So we'll have a 30-minute break, which means at five to 1.00 we'll start again.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. McCloskey?

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Mr. Ruez, we've finished up with the school and can you now briefly describe what you learned from the survivors as to what happened next so we can see that in the context of the investigation?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. So taken out truck by truck, out of this wardrobe at the Grbavci school, four survivors claim having made a short trip on board of this truck. The assessment varied from five minutes to 20 minutes for one of them. And taken to a nearby meadow where they faced execution.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay, well, let's get your first exhibit in that regard at 135. And we see the Grbavci school on the left side of the screen and can you orient us?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: First the left side of the screen, you can see just one little part of the Grbavci school. There is a line running from the left, that is the direction of the main road going from Zvornik to Tuzla. You can so first see at the bottom of the picture the asphalt road, it's labelled "road" going towards the right of the picture and at the top, the straight line is the railroad that follows the same direction. So very exactly 800 metres to the right of this Grbavci school, so going towards direction north, are two meadows that we could identify precisely only through the aerial imagery that was provided. One of them we named site 1. This is the site behind the railroad. And the other one we name it site 2.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: But I think there is an additional confusion on this because, in fact, here the labels are reversed.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. We'll sort that out as we go and we'll remember that 135 needs to be reversed, 2 and 1; is that right?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, because the site labelled site 2 is the one that was for the exhumation process labelled LZ 1. That meant at that time Lazete, which was a hamlet nearby, number 1. And the one labelled execution site 1 on this photograph is labelled LZ 2 during the exhumation process.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. And just to be clear, how were you able to find these two places that you labelled here as execution sites?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Only thanks to aerial imagery. Without that imagery, I don't believe we would have fund these locations.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Let's go then to the next shot, 136, which is US aerial imagery and it's one of these split shots, and July 5 on the left, July 27 on the right. Can you just describe what that means to the investigation?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. So two main features on these photographs. The line at the top left on the two pictures is the asphalt road, and the straight line at the bottom right, to the top right, is the railroad line. One can see on 5th July, a long dirt road that connects the asphalt road to an area that is behind the railroad.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's put the little hand there and have the hand go kind of across the railroad?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is a dirt road that goes through an underpass under the railroad, and then reaches the area where soil has been obviously removed between the 5th July and the 27 July.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. So if we go over to the 27 July photo, can you just tell us where the -- well, I think we can see it but starting with the asphalt road, show us the area of the disturbed soil?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. There are also two areas of disturbance, one behind the railroad, this one, and one just at the angle of the asphalt road and of the dirt road, this one.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Now, can't be seen from this image but can you tell us from your knowledge of the ground how this little dirt road gets by there railroad? I mean --

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: It goes through an underpass.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Now, taking this imagery, what were you able to do?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: We were able to find this location and search the ground for evidence of possible mass grave site in this place.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to the next shot which orients us a bit more. And the purpose of this shot, which I believe was the same as the other but it now has yellow markings?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, correct. These yellow markings --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: One moment. This wouldn't tally with the correction that you made to the previous one or -- because LZ 1 appears to be the one which was site 1 in the first place. And LZ 2 corresponds with site 2 as it appears on the prefer photo.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Can you explain that, Mr. Ruez?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: All I need is an explanation, that's all I want.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: In fact, no, because on another picture, I turn it through another angle because this angle here creates a confusion. In fact, the one that is labelled LZ 1 on this photograph is on the previous exhibit site 2. The problem is that it is seen from a different direction.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: I see.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: On the next exhibit, I will have turned there aerial photograph in another angle so that you can connect with this picture here.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Let's then go to 136. So we do see one that is mislabelled again so it gets slightly confusing but this 137 is correctly labelled; is that right?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, this is right. The confusion with this numbering might be explained at a later stage. It is in fact due to our initial assumption that the first execution site was the first one. In fact it appeared that the first one was the one we labelled number 2.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Well, that's not something we need to deal with?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: So let's go to the next, 138. And I think this is labelled incorrectly; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. This is incorrect indeed. This is LZ 2 -- sorry, yes. This is LZ 2.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: It has to be because if it's next to the railway tracks it cannot be LD 1.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: This is LZ 2.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay in relation to that asphalt road, this is the farthest away from the asphalt road, is that right?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. So this is photographed from the railroad track and it shows the area that can be seen on the aerial imagery where the area of disturbance is still very visible. It is pointed by the yellow arrow.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: So for the record we will correct the final version of this so it's labelled properly. All right. Let's go to the next one, 139. And what is this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is the same area of disturbance at LZ 2 with the first check of the surface where a certain number of items were labelled. They are all on a log. I will only show a few samples of it.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Let's go on to the next one, to begin to do that. 140. What are we --

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So on this one, where the yellow marker number 25 is, there is a bone that is a human bone, a femur.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Let's go to the next one, 141.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Under the marker number 32 is a human jaw.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Let's go to the next one, 142?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Let's not draw conclusions that it is a human -- leave it to the experts, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Mr. Ruez, how do you know -- why do you make that conclusion?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: I make this conclusion because we were on the spot with Professor bill Haglund who named us the bones that we were coming across.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Let's go to 142. What do we see there?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Under the marker 17, a shell casing.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Let's go to the next one, 143.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: On this one, number -- label 43 is a piece of cloth with a knot and a piece of clothing coming out of the soil.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Let's go to the next one, 144.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this photograph is just to show reference with the site where some of these items were found, number 17 and number 43.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to 145. What's this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is an area that was described by one of the survivors as being a so-called rest area for the soldiers of the execution squad.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. And let me direct your attention to that white, just behind that white truck. What is that little dark area with the railing up by that white truck?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This opening on the hill that supports the railroad is the so-called underpass that leads to the other side.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to 146.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So on this grassy area, supposed to be the rest area, we found a few carton boxes which are envelopes for 7.62 millimetre rounds.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to the next one, 147. What's this of?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: At the tree line on the top of this little hilly area, we found a box of -- an aluminium box that on the next picture we will see is an empty ammunition box.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Let's go to 148?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: That's a box that contained at one point, rounds of 7.62 millimetre bullets.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And you just get that by reading that label which may be difficult to read from this picture; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Let's go to 149. What is this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is an ammunition box that was not found on the spot. It's totally disconnected. But its aim is to show how an ammunition box is made of. First a wooden shell, then the aluminium box and inside, a certain number of little carton boxes with labels that contain the rounds.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to 150. What's this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is a view of this site, LZ 2. The area of disturbance that stretches towards the right of the picture. The so-called rest area core donned with yellow tape, and the arrow marks the direction that one has to take going through the underpass in order to reach the other site, Lazete 1.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: For that, let's go to 151. Tell us about the perspective, where we are now?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So again, this picture is taken from the railroad looking into the direction of the asphalt road that leads to the school, if you turn to the right, and the area with the dotted circle marks the location of the second execution site and mass grave of this area.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. And just to summarise, let's go to the next shot. What is this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is an extract of the video filmed by helicopter that shows at the bottom the arrow shows the direction when coming from the Grbavci school. Then the first execution site that was used and that is labelled LZ 2. And then just at the edge of the asphalt road, the second site that is labelled LZ 1.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to the next spot, 153. What is this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is an area at approximately 200 metres away from the site LZ 2. It will be pinpointed on another photograph seen from the air. And it is an area where we found a pile of trash alongside of the dirt road.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Let's go to 154. And what is this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is a still picture that I took during the search we conducted at this pile of trash.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. And we'll get a closer look at this on the video; is that right?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, absolutely.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. So then let's go to the next shot, which was 155, which we have seen before but you have a marking. What's that, the dump site?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: In addition to the previous exhibit, this one is marking the location where we found this dump site alongside of a dirt road, a little bit away from the execution and burial areas.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. And we now have a -- on your outline, a video that should be about five minutes. And it's 65 ter 1718. And if you could provide your brief narrative.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: So again the school, the school seen from the air, going for the moment towards the opposite direction where the sites are. The road going north towards the sites, the railroad at the left. Now it's following the road towards the sites. And here I will be zooming towards the two sites. Here are the two sites. Now it's filmed from the ground and it's Peter Nicholson filming. And this is dated April 1996. So this is site 2. Obvious disturbance on the ground.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Was that disturbance done by the ICTY?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, negative. The only disturbance we did that day was to do a probe in the mud.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: So this is the area where we started a search in this mud. Professor Bill Haglund is currently digging with the assistance of two colleagues, Jean Pierre Capelle and Frederick Buckley.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Which one is Haglund because everybody is digging?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The one with the hat and the yellow clothing is Professor Haglund and the colour of the mud is greenish colour. This is what attracted him to this specific area, since that colour is characteristic of mud that has been in contact with rottening bodies.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: This is a shell casing. Without the sound, I couldn't tell, but he's giving explanations about human bone at this moment, or flesh or clothing. This is now the area of the dump site. So this is the result of the search inside this dump site. A certain number of socks that we are counting at this moment. Pieces of clothing. Hats, some hand-made, some fabric. And quite a large number of pieces of cloth, around 100, some having knots. Live ammunition. Spare ammunition. Documents, photographs.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. I notice from your outline that that is the end of the Orahovac grave sections for now but at the end of your outline you plan to go back to some of these execution sites and speak about issues related to what's happened to them after July 1995; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. So just to orient us there. All right. Now, the next site you've identified in this section we have the Petkovci School and the Petkovci dam, but before we get to those, can you tell me, the Petkovci School and the Petkovci dam which one of these locations did the investigation identify first?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The first location identified was the dam because initially, we even thought that the people who had been executed at the dam were also coming from the Grbavci school. So it took a bit longer to identify the Petkovci School.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. We'll -- I'll ask you about how you found the dam but since we start with the school, can you tell us how, after finding the dam, did you find the school?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Finding the school was then easy because it was not far away from the dam, and by asking the locals, we could identify that school that was matching the precise descriptions given then by the two survivors of this spot.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. And how, once you found this school, based on what the local folks had told you, how did you match that up, if you did, to the survivors?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: By taking photographs of the location and showing the pictures to the survivors.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Well, then, let's start with a -- the Petkovci School and let's go to the next photograph, 157. Tell us what this is?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is a helicopter view of the school and the area around the school. The asphalt road at the bottom of the picture is going to the right towards the dam. That is the waste of the aluminium factory at Karakaj and just after Karakaj is Zvornik so -- the dam and the general direction of Zvornik [check that].

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right, so let's --

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: One can see it's on top of a slope that has some relevance then with what the witnesses will say.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And about, if you remember, about how far is this school from the dam site?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: By road, it is approximately three kilometres, three, four kilometres by road.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Now, let's go to the next shot, 158. What's this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is a picture of the front of the school, when photographed from a meadow that is in front of it.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And was there a particular purpose in getting this angle of the school?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. One survivor said that there were some guards on this meadow who were shooting at the prisoners where someone was standing to get some fresh air.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Let's go to the next shot, 159. What is this depicting?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is again the same school but seen from the back, where there is a parking place or a play ground and then specific architecture that leads one to the entrance of the school by going down a series of stairs.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: What's the yellow arrow for?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The yellow arrow is marking the school, pointing to the school.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to the next one, 160. What's this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is the view one has when he arrives on this parking lot and goes down the stairs towards the entrance of the school.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And did you receive any descriptions from any of the survivors that were consistent with this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. Both descriptions were consistent with this.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Let's go to the next shot. What's this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is a photograph of the inside, showing that it is a school with two floors.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: What's the significance of two floors?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: It matches the description given by at least one I remember very well, of one of these two survivors.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to the next shot.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is a staircase that goes from the ground floor towards the first floor.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Let's go to the next shot. What's this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is the corridor at the top floor. When we brought the witness back to the spot, he pointed at the last door at this corridor, turning right, as being the classroom where he was hold.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to the next one, 164. What is this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is the inside of the school that the witness pointed to us. He had told previously about a stove that one can see here. The entire classroom was renovated. Nevertheless, there was still this blackboard that is in fact a green board that was obviously not renovated.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to the next shot, 165. What are these little circles depicting?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: These circles are depicting holes, bullet holes, in this blackboard.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Let's go to the next shot, a close-up, 166.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is a close shot of a bullet hole on this blackboard.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Let's go to the next shot, 167.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Now it is the exit of the prisoner who had been held in this classroom, so going first towards this corridor.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to the next shot.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: And then getting down the stairs, that have a very specific shape.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. So that's the end of the school at Petkovci. Now we go to the dam. Let's go to the next map graphic. Similar to that -- we've seen similar to that. So let's go to 170. Can you tell us what this is?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is the what we call the plateau of the dam, which is the execution and burial site of the prisoners who were taken from Petkovci School to this area.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Can you orient us? You say it's a dam. I don't see any water. Where -- describe how the dam works, if you could. Just in relation to this picture.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The dirt road that can be seen at the right, middle right of the picture, is the dirt road that leads towards the asphalt road, and then either direction of the school, either direction towards Karakaj. This is the bottom of the dam and one can see the wall of the dam at the left corner of the picture, and it's going uphill like this. It is not a lake. It is the waste, the water waste, of the aluminum factory of Karakaj. So it's a red water dam.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to 171. These are September dates. These are -- that's out of order. So let's skip that.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Never mind, because it will be the same between 5th and 27, more or less. This is only to indicate the area where disturbance can be seen, and that area of disturbance matches a site on this plateau that one can see from the ground was indeed obviously disturbed. So this shows in fact what led us to search a specific area of this plateau.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Where would the water be in relation to these split images?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: At the bottom of the picture, in fact, you can see the dirt road that then leads to the plateau, and this is the plateau. The wall would be on the right-hand of these two photographs.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to the next shot, 172. What is this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So here taking first totally at the left is the dirt road that is coming from the direction of the asphalt road. Then approaching the site, you have this -- at the left of the picture, this area where the soil looks a bit yellow, and this is the area of the disturbance. We made a collection of shell casings and pieces of human skull on this entire surface. That area will be shown a bit later, but the small picture at the top is a picture taken of one of the two survivors on that spot, precisely on that spot, and the blue arrow points the position where this person told me he had been shot at when he was taken to the plateau.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Let's go to the next one. What's the significance -- first of all, what is this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is a picture showing the side of the plateau, and the goal of it is to show some concrete ditch that is running alongside this plateau, and the two survivors claim having crawlen out of the site, reached concrete ditch and then they crawled towards a forest in front. We could see the forest on the previous picture, forest hill.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to the next shot. Can you describe this now?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: M'hm. So on this view, that is taken from north towards south, sorry, from, yes, north to south, one can see the red water of the dam. Then in between the red water and the black line is, in fact, the wall of the dam. And the white area more at the top of this dam is the plateau.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And what -- we see blue arrows. What do the blue arrows depict?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The first blue arrow depicts the trip that the two survivors made to crawl towards the hill covered by a forest, that is just in front, and the second dotted line that goes from the right to the left indicates the direction they took on 15 July when it took them nearly a day to crawl uphill in that direction, time during which they talk about a certain number of events.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go on to the next spot. Is this -- we are at 175, sorry, we are still at the dam. Can you indicate what this means?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: These arrows show the same thing, seen from a different angle. This is the direction the two men took to escape from the area.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to the next spot. And again, what's this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this picture shows that at the left of the dam is a continuity of the gravel road, the dirt road, that goes uphill and then would be lost of sight from someone who would be downhill, and reaches a location we named the peninsula that enters a bit in the red waters of the lake.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Let's go on to the next shot. Who is the person in this shot, 177?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The person at the left is Professor Bill Haglund.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And did he report to you what these things were that he's photographing?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, indeed. This was the first approach of the site in April 1996 and among the numerous pieces of bones we could find on the surface, Professor Haglund collected some of them and on the video describes what part of the human skeleton these are part of.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to the next shot, 178. What do we have here in the circle?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This was during a mission done in summer 1997, in order to prepare a future exhumation of the site. We probed one area of the suspect mass grave site that is at the area of disturbance on the photograph, aerial photograph, and here, approximately ten centimetres under the ground we found a piece of cloth with a knot.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Let's go to the next shot.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is the piece of cloth put on a hard surface to have a better picture of it.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to the next one, 180. What is this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: That same day, continuing to dig through these rocks, we found at 60 centimetres under the soil what is a piece of human skull, marked with the yellow arrow at the moment we found it.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Let's go to the next shot, 181. What's that?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is a split image of the piece of skull that we saw on the previous picture.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This was identified as a human skull by pathologist Jose Baraybar.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: We have three more photos, we should be able to get to them pretty quickly. 182, what is this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Among large collection of skull fragments scattered on top of the surface of the plateau of the dam, I requested Jose Baraybar to give us a little sampling of what type of bones these were. So he -- on this photograph it shows some samples of various skull fragments.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Thank you. Let's go to the next shot. And what's this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: As the result also of this first possibility we had to check in detail the surface of the plateau of the dam, we collected a number of shell casings that would have to be added to the number provided in the report made by Professor Richard Wright since during this collection we took from the surface of the dam 1031 shell casings which are in the bags that one can see on this picture.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: In what year was this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This was during the summer of 1996. It was either -- I can hardly say.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Could be -- could be June. We made several during that summer and I might mix a few of them.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to the last shot for today. What is this yellow perimeter depict?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is a marking of the -- of the area where we collected most of the casings and most the skull fragments. They were scattered all over this area.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: I think it's a good time to break.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: I thank you, Mr. McCloskey. I thank you, Mr. Ruez. We will reconvene tomorrow in the afternoon, 2.15, in this same courtroom. Thank you.
